ceo_verdict_summary.ceo_position: Would NOT promote Layer A. Would also NOT claim adhesion is fundamentally unmeasurable. The correct state is: 'The proposed force-decomposition protocol is experimentally/model-wise unstable under realistic clot mechanics, and existing sensing/control prior art substantially occupies adjacent capabilities. The current Layer-A implementation is therefore KILLED.'

ceo_p0_corrections.issue: '16 unknowns, 3 observables' is NOT a proof by itself. Time-series structure, known parameter constraints, controlled inputs, priors, imaging-derived states, and repeated experiments can increase information. The count itself is not the proof.
ceo_p0_corrections.correct_action: Show an actual observability/rank failure OR an explicit pair of physically distinct states producing indistinguishable measurements. The Round-58 file does NOT do this for the universal case; it only does this for the chosen M3+M4 model.

ceo_p0_corrections.issue: The synthetic +112% bias is model-dependent. It is generated from the coder's chosen M3/M4 model. It demonstrates: 'This particular estimator fails badly under this particular realistic perturbation model.' It does NOT establish that every possible estimator or measurement protocol fails.
ceo_p0_corrections.correct_action: Record the +112% as model-conditional evidence against the constant-tail estimator under M3+M4. Do NOT record it as universal non-identifiability.

ceo_p0_corrections.issue: The patent landscape is actually stronger evidence against the proposed layer than the +112% bias. EP4637580A1 describes force sensing on a thrombus (pulling force + attachment monitoring). US20260000423A1 explicitly describes sensor feedback for therapy mode selection. US11504151B2 describes a scraper adjusting expansion and pull force to maintain target force while scraping clot from the vessel wall. So 'force sensing + feedback' is materially occupied.
ceo_p0_corrections.correct_action: Treat the prior art as substantial occupation of the adjacent capability space, not as total occupation of the entire scientific question.

what_is_killed.killed_implementation: Layer A: clot-vessel adhesion sensing via controlled perturbation (force decomposition), v1
kill_reasons_bounded: BOUNDED-1: Under the tested M3+M4 realistic model (changing contact area + time-varying adhesion), the constant-tail force-decomposition estimator exhibits +112% bias. This kills THIS estimator under THIS model.

BOUNDED-4: Adjacent prior art (EP4637580A1, US20260000423A1, US11504151B2) materially occupies 'force sensing + feedback' for thrombectomy.

candidate_freeze_directives.frozen_candidate: Layer A force-decomposition adhesion estimator v1
forbidden_rescue_attempts: any other re-skin of the same force-decomposition idea
candidate_freeze_directives.rationale: These are attempts to rescue a failed implementation. Per Article XXIX, a failed embodiment cannot kill the invention unless the design space is exhausted. Conversely, a failed embodiment cannot rescue the invention by re-skinning. The implementation is FROZEN at v1-KILLED. If the scientific question is to be revisited, it must be via a fundamentally different sensing modality or protocol, not a dressed-up version of force decomposition.

CE-016.new_rule: A proposed latent quantity survives only when identifiability is demonstrated under an explicit observation/dynamics model AND remains identifiable under plausible model uncertainty. The burden is bidirectional: a single favorable rank calculation is insufficient; a single unfavorable perturbation model is also insufficient.

CE-017.new_rule: Structural identifiability under a convenient model is not enough. A candidate must survive adversarial model uncertainty and practical operation (safety, timing, decision value). The pushing-the-envelope principle: a discovery engine earns trust when it attacks its own successful proof harder than its unsuccessful ideas.

pivot_directions.principle: Per CEO directive: do NOT spend another ten rounds trying to measure adhesion. The stroke recalcitrant-clot problem remains real, but this particular pathway is exhausted at the current evidence boundary.

candidate_pivot_axes.description: Abandon force as the sensing channel entirely. Consider clot composition imaging (OCT, Raman, near-infrared), acoustic emission during retrieval, or electrical bioimpedance of the clot-vessel interface. None of these are 'force decomposition in disguise' — they interrogate a different physical quantity.

Abandon adhesion-breaking entirely. Consider pharmacological weakening of the clot-vessel interface (e.g., locally delivered tPA, GP IIb/IIIa), thermal weakening, or ultrasonic cavitation. These do not require measuring adhesion at all.

Abandon first-pass strategy selection. Consider post-hoc outcome prediction (which patient will have symptomatic ICH, which patient will have TICI 2c vs 3), or device selection (stent-retriever vs aspiration vs combined) based on clot characterization rather than adhesion.
Abandon recalcitrant clots. Consider distal embolization prevention, no-reflow phenomenon, or neuroprotection during reperfusion.

Slot 5 may remain EMPTY. Per the prior portfolio audit, 3 invention territories (IIH/VSS, RES-4, Stroke v1) have been exhausted at the current evidence boundary. CEO decision needed: (a) explore a different stroke axis (AXIS-1 through AXIS-4), (b) propose an entirely new medical device problem, (c) accept Slot 5 as empty.

pivot_directions.explicit_non_pivot: Any further attempt to measure adhesion via force decomposition (including v2, AI, neural network, 'smarter' classifier, or any other re-skin) is FORBIDDEN by the candidate freeze directives above.

strongest_alternative_explanation_per_ar.for_the_+112pct_bias: The strongest alternative explanation for the +112% bias is that the constant-tail estimator was tested against a perturbation model (M3+M4) chosen by the same agent that designed the estimator. A different estimator (e.g., a Stribeck-aware observer, a Prony-series fitter with explicit contact-area state, or a Bayesian filter with informative priors on the relaxation time constants) may perform differently under M3+M4. This does NOT rescue the implementation — the implementation is killed for the additional reasons of clinical risk, timing failure, and patent occupation. But the alternative explanation must be stated honestly: the +112% is a property of the (estimator, model) pair, not of the underlying physics.
strongest_alternative_explanation_per_ar.for_the_kill_decision: The strongest alternative explanation for the kill decision is that the candidate was a bad implementation of a real idea, not a bad idea. The kill is therefore implementation-level, not mechanism-level. This is consistent with Article XXIX. The broader scientific question (can adhesion be measured by ANY protocol?) remains open.
